title: Adiabatic controlled-$Z$ gate for neutral atoms with Förster-enhanced Rydberg dressing
summary: We study an adiabatic controlled-$Z$ (CZ) gate for neutral atoms in which dipole-dipole coupling between nearly degenerate Rydberg pair states enhances the interaction between dressed ground states. This coupling produces an avoided crossing in the two-atom dressed-state spectrum. Approaching the crossing enhances the dressed interaction, but also reduces the dressed-state gap and increases the Rydberg admixture.
